about.title: About Mesquite ISD
about.content: Mesquite Independent School District is a public school district serving Mesquite, Texas and surrounding Dallas County communities in the Dallas-Fort Worth area of North Texas. The district serves PK-12 families and follows a traditional academic calendar with districtwide student holidays, professional learning days, instructional alignment days, classroom workdays, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, early release days, graduation dates, and school hours.

about.title: How to Use This Mesquite ISD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide Mesquite ISD calendar planning, then confirm campus events, testing windows, athletics, graduation details, weather closures, and same-day announcements through Mesquite ISD or your student's campus. The district calendar also marks A days and workdays for 226-day personnel, which may matter for staff and program planning.

customSections.label: Mesquite ISD Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: Mesquite ISD calendar planning is especially useful for families comparing Dallas-Fort Worth and Dallas County school schedules. Families should pay attention to professional learning days, instructional alignment days, early release days, graduation dates, and any bad weather day notation before treating a date as final for childcare, travel, or work planning.

planningTips.title: Mesquite ISD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the district calendar PDF for districtwide student holidays, breaks, early release days, graduation dates, and school start and end dates.
Check early release times by school level because elementary, middle school, high school, and Vanguard use different release times.
Treat bad weather days as conditional planning dates until Mesquite ISD confirms whether they will be used.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

comparisonTitle: Mesquite ISD Compared With Nearby Texas Districts
compareIntro: Use this nearby-district reference to compare Mesquite ISD with other Dallas-Fort Worth calendar pages currently available on MySchoolDates. Dates shown include the first day, last day, and spring break.

districtFaqs.q: Does Mesquite ISD publish early release times?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The district calendar lists early release times for elementary, middle school, high school, and Vanguard.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Mesquite ISD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Mesquite ISD calendar page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Mesquite ISD.
